spreads.scene: A young child Nuna is looking at a small seed in her hand. A squirrel is looking at a nut in its paws. They are in a grassy field with a few flowers, under a clear sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna cava um buraco no chão.
left.en: Nuna digs a hole in the ground.
left.es-MX: Nuna cava un hoyo en el suelo.

right.pt-BR: Um esquilo cava um buraco para esconder.
right.en: A squirrel digs a hole to hide.
right.es-MX: Una ardilla cava un hoyo para esconder.

spreads.scene: A young child Nuna is kneeling and digging in soft earth with a small shovel. A squirrel is digging in the earth with its paws. They are in a garden with a distant fence under a bright sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna coloca a semente na terra.
left.en: Nuna puts the seed in the earth.
left.es-MX: Nuna pone la semilla en la tierra.

right.pt-BR: Um esquilo coloca a noz no buraco.
right.en: A squirrel puts the nut in the hole.
right.es-MX: Una ardilla pone la nuez en el hoyo.

spreads.scene: A young child Nuna is gently placing a small seed into a shallow hole in the soil. A squirrel is carefully placing a nut into a hole in the soil. They are in a close-up view of dark earth, under a clear sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna cobre a semente com terra.
left.en: Nuna covers the seed with soil.
left.es-MX: Nuna cubre la semilla con tierra.

right.pt-BR: Um esquilo cobre a noz com terra.
right.en: A squirrel covers the nut with soil.
right.es-MX: Una ardilla cubre la nuez con tierra.

spreads.scene: A young child Nuna is using her hands to push soil over a planted seed. A squirrel is using its paws to push soil over a buried nut. They are in a garden bed with green leaves nearby, under a bright sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna rega a semente com água.
left.en: Nuna waters the seed with water.
left.es-MX: Nuna riega la semilla con agua.

right.pt-BR: Um pássaro bebe água na poça.
right.en: A bird drinks water from a puddle.
right.es-MX: Un pájaro bebe agua de un charco.

spreads.scene: A young child Nuna is gently pouring water from a small watering can onto the ground. A bird is bending its head to drink water from a small puddle. They are in a green garden, under a soft blue sky.

right.pt-BR: Um pássaro espera, o sol se move.
right.en: A bird waits, the sun moves.
right.es-MX: Un pájaro espera, el sol se mueve.

spreads.scene: A young child Nuna is sitting patiently on the ground, looking at the spot where she planted the seed. A bird is perched quietly on a branch, looking at the sky. They are in a garden with long shadows, under an evening sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna rega de novo. Mais água.
left.es-MX: Nuna riega de nuevo. Más agua.

right.pt-BR: Uma formiga bebe gotas de chuva.
right.es-MX: Una hormiga bebe gotas de lluvia.

spreads.scene: A young child Nuna is pouring water from a watering can onto the earth. An ant is drinking from a tiny water droplet on a leaf. They are in a wet garden with large leaves, under a cloudy sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna se inclina para ver de perto.
left.en: Nuna leans in to see closely.
left.es-MX: Nuna se inclina para ver de cerca.

right.en: An earthworm comes up from the ground.
right.es-MX: Una lombriz sale de la tierra.

spreads.scene: A young child Nuna is bending down, looking intently at the ground. An earthworm is emerging from the soil, its head visible. They are in a garden with rich dark earth, under a bright sky.

A young child Nuna is pointing with surprise and joy at a tiny green sprout emerging from the soil. A small green leaf is unfurling from a stem. They are in a garden with brown earth, under a sunny sky.

A young child Nuna is happily looking at a small green plant with two leaves. A squirrel is curiously looking at a similar small green plant. They are in a garden with some pebbles on the ground, under a bright sky.

left.en: The little plant grows, Nuna smiles.

right.pt-BR: A semente da Nuna vira flor.
right.es-MX: La semilla de Nuna se convierte en flor.

spreads.scene: A young child Nuna is smiling at a slightly taller plant with more leaves. A flower is blooming on a plant, attracting a bee. They are in a vibrant green garden, under a sunny sky.

left.en: What a beautiful flower Nuna has!

right.pt-BR: Um pássaro canta para a flor.
right.en: A bird sings to the flower.
right.es-MX: Un pájaro canta a la flor.

spreads.scene: A young child Nuna is admiring a fully bloomed flower with several petals. A bird is perched on a branch near a similar blooming flower, singing. They are in a colorful flower garden, under a clear blue sky.
